development_population.role: mechanism/integrity diagnostic only; no tuning permitted

dose_control.distinctness: when another k-subset exists, selected removal subset must differ from exact target-family removal subset
dose_control.operation: remove exactly the same number k of currently-active residual bits as the target family ablation at that state
dose_control.purpose: separate family identity from generic loss of k active bits
dose_control.selection: deterministic SHA-256 ordering over active indices keyed by target family and current native grid

family_ablation.operation: at every TRM guidance query, zero only currently-active matched residual bits whose signature kind equals target family

global_verdict_rule: PASS if at least one preregistered active family satisfies the localization rule; otherwise NEGATIVE. Report all five families regardless of result.
hard_invariants: family ablation can only turn active matched residual bits off
dose control can only turn active matched residual bits off
TRM cannot apply a move directly
R0.3 final population remains unopened until source/tests freeze
inactive_family_policy: not used as necessity arms because authority sampling observed zero active residual occurrences
localization_rule: a family is localized as causally necessary only if both primary and specificity directional clauses hold on the frozen final population with integrity gates passing
primary_family_clause: family necessity direction: matched resolved_count > family-ablated resolved_count
scientific_question: Which native structural residual families are causally necessary for the R0.2 matched-guidance search advantage?

search_contract.rng_pairing: fresh identical Random(base_seed + fixture_index) per arm

secondary_endpoints: paired steps-to-resolution on jointly resolved fixtures
number of TRM guidance choices actually altered
specificity_family_clause: family specificity direction: count-control resolved_count > family-ablated resolved_count
